spec.description: Reference per-cluster capacity availability (GPUs) and service availability (Kubernetes API). All queried series must carry a `k8s_cluster_name` label. Extra installs: NVIDIA GPU Operator with DCGM Exporter; kube-apiserver scrape for apiserver_request_total; NVSentinel Janitor (https://github.com/NVIDIA/NVSentinel). Missing optional dependencies leave their panels empty.

options.content:
### Assumptions
- Every queried series has a `k8s_cluster_name` label. Select one or more clusters with the variable above.
- **Capacity availability** is GPU node and allocatable-GPU inventory (raw counts).
- **Service availability** is Kubernetes API success from `apiserver_request_total`. Errors are HTTP 5xx and 429. The **availability target** variable is a policy choice used only for burn-rate and error-budget panels; observed error rates do not depend on it.

### Metric dependencies
- **kube-state-metrics:** node capacity, readiness, scheduling, conditions, and GPU Operator pod health
- **node_exporter:** reboot and network metrics

### Extra installs (panels stay empty without them)
- **NVIDIA GPU Operator and DCGM Exporter:** GPU model, temperature, utilization, power, thermal, clock-throttle, XID, and `gpu_operator_nodes_upgrades_*`. Not part of this chart. See [NVIDIA/gpu-operator](https://github.com/NVIDIA/gpu-operator).
- **kube-apiserver request metrics:** `apiserver_request_total` with a `k8s_cluster_name` label. NKTP does not scrape the API server by default; you must scrape kube-apiserver (or an equivalent control-plane job) and keep the `k8s_cluster_name` label.
- **NVSentinel Janitor:** reboot and GPU-reset count/latency metrics (`janitor_actions_count`, `janitor_action_mttr_seconds`, `gpu_reset_*`). See [NVIDIA/NVSentinel](https://github.com/NVIDIA/NVSentinel).

Missing optional dependencies leave their corresponding panels empty.

panels.title: Capacity availability (GPUs)
panels.description: Raw GPU node and allocatable GPU counts for the selected clusters.

targets.expr: count((group by (k8s_cluster_name, node) (kube_node_status_capacity{resource=~"nvidia_com_gpu|nvidia_com_pgpu",k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster"} > 0)) and on (k8s_cluster_name,node) (kube_node_status_condition{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster",condition="Ready",status="true"} == 1) unless on (k8s_cluster_name,node) (kube_node_spec_unschedulable{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster"} == 1))

count((group by (k8s_cluster_name, node) (kube_node_status_capacity{resource=~"nvidia_com_gpu|nvidia_com_pgpu",k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster"} > 0)) unless on (k8s_cluster_name,node) (kube_node_status_condition{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster",condition="Ready",status="true"} == 1)) or vector(0)

count((group by (k8s_cluster_name, node) (kube_node_status_capacity{resource=~"nvidia_com_gpu|nvidia_com_pgpu",k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster"} > 0)) and on (k8s_cluster_name,node) (kube_node_spec_unschedulable{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster"} == 1)) or vector(0)

sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource=~"nvidia_com_gpu|nvidia_com_pgpu",k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster"} and on (k8s_cluster_name,node) ((group by (k8s_cluster_name, node) (kube_node_status_capacity{resource=~"nvidia_com_gpu|nvidia_com_pgpu",k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster"} > 0)) and on (k8s_cluster_name,node) (kube_node_status_condition{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster",condition="Ready",status="true"} == 1) unless on (k8s_cluster_name,node) (kube_node_spec_unschedulable{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster"} == 1)))

panels.title: Control-plane targets reporting
panels.description: Raw count of healthy, scraped control-plane component targets; managed providers may not expose every component.

panels.title: GPU models
panels.description: Requires DCGM Exporter and its modelName label.

panels.title: Node health
panels.description: Requires kube-state-metrics and node_exporter; GPU panels additionally require NVIDIA DCGM Exporter.

targets.expr: sum by (k8s_cluster_name,Hostname,err_msg,err_code) (DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster"} > 0 and ignoring(instance) (DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS != 43 and DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS != 109 and DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS != 31))

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Requires node_exporter metrics with a `k8s_cluster_name` label.

panels.title: Component health — GPU Operator
panels.description: Pod health requires kube-state-metrics. Rollout status requires GPU Operator upgrade-controller metrics.

panels.title: Service availability (Kubernetes API)
panels.description: API server availability from apiserver_request_total. Error ratio is 5xx+429 over all requests, summed by cluster. Burn rate and error-budget panels divide by (100 - $availability_target) / 100.

panels.title: API server success rate — 30d lookback
panels.description: 100 minus the 30d average of the 5m error ratio (Prometheus subquery step 5m).

panels.title: Burn rates
panels.description: A burn rate below 1 stays within budget; above 1 consumes budget faster than allowed.

panels.title: Availability target
panels.description: Value of the availability target dashboard variable. Not derived from telemetry.

panels.title: Allowed error budget
panels.description: Allowed error budget as 100 minus the availability target. Not derived from telemetry.

panels.title: Consumed error budget
panels.description: 30d average error ratio divided by the allowed error budget.

panels.title: API server status
panels.description: 1 means a scraped target is up. No data may be expected when a managed provider does not expose this component.

panels.title: etcd status
panels.description: 1 means a scraped target is up. No data may be expected when a managed provider does not expose this component.

panels.title: Scheduler status
panels.description: 1 means a scraped target is up. No data may be expected when a managed provider does not expose this component.

panels.title: Controller manager status
panels.description: 1 means a scraped target is up. No data may be expected when a managed provider does not expose this component.

panels.title: Janitor reboots
panels.description: Requires NVSentinel Janitor metrics. This module may be disabled and produce no data.

panels.title: Janitor GPU resets
panels.description: Requires NVSentinel GPU reset metrics. This module may be disabled and produce no data.

list.label: Cluster
list.description: Prometheus label `k8s_cluster_name` (OTel resource `k8s.cluster.name`) used by every dashboard section.

list.name: availability_target
list.label: Availability target %
list.description: Desired API success percent. Used only for burn-rate and error-budget math. Observed 5xx+429 rates do not use this value.
